canonical_definition: TextVQA is a visual question answering benchmark that assesses the ability to read and understand text in images. The measurement instrument evaluates models' capabilities in text recognition within visual scenes through question answering tasks that require interpreting textual content from images. Some papers frame it as an OCR-centric task or as a proxy for text recognition ability in visual contexts, with variants emphasizing its role in evaluating models' general capability retention or performance in text-intensive scenarios.
